description: Project-scoped Guardian operations with Adaptive Guardian Intelligence, Benchmark Replay, Coverage Intelligence, governed Benchmark Vault learning, fingerprinted evaluation, approvals, and verified runtime workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Operate adaptive verified Guardian intelligence workflows
interface.longDescription: Plan, operate, evaluate, learn, and review project-scoped Nexus Starship Guardians workflows. v0.7 adds Adaptive Guardian Intelligence for specialist AI architects, platform engineers, AI developers, coder/debugging specialists, AI engineers/scientists, cloud specialists, API specialists, and AI programmers. Verified outcomes update per-skill evidence, confidence, trend, benchmark performance, training priorities, and a bounded routing bonus. Benchmark Replay re-runs review candidates before approval, while Coverage Intelligence measures benchmark breadth across architecture, platform, coding, debugging, AI/ML, cloud, API, security, database, UI, deployment, tool-use, evaluation, and reliability. Automatic learning cannot grant permissions, mutate model weights live, or silently approve benchmark truth.
capabilities: Adapt specialist Guardian skill evidence from verified outcomes
Route missions using bounded evidence from proven specialist strengths
Replay Benchmark Vault candidates before governed review
Measure benchmark coverage and snapshot-to-snapshot category growth
Generate targeted training priorities from weak, uncertain, or regressing skills
Evaluate baseline and candidate strategies against fingerprinted fixed corpora
Grow future benchmark snapshots through evidence-linked regression candidates and explicit review
Run and inspect authorized Guardian tasks without inferring permissions from performance
defaultPrompt: Show the adaptive intelligence summary and training priorities for my specialist Guardians.
Replay pending Benchmark Vault candidates and summarize which failures reproduce.
Analyze benchmark coverage gaps across architecture, coding, debugging, AI, cloud, API, security, database, UI, deployment, and tool-use.
Route this mission using verified specialist performance evidence without changing tool permissions.
Compare a baseline and candidate using the Guardian Intelligence Lab and show promotion evidence.
